user.title: Add a local 352 device
user.description: Discover 352 devices already connected to your network, or probe a known IP address. Legacy Air and newer Life devices are identified from their actual responses.

confirm_model.title: Confirm the device model
confirm_model.description: This device replied with a protocol family shared by the models below. Confirm the retail model from its label. This is not the full support list; manual setup offers all supported models.

schedule_cleanup.title: Handle device-local recurring schedules
schedule_cleanup.description: Optionally clear all four recurring on/off schedule slots stored inside the purifier. This is off by default and does not delete Home Assistant automations. When selected, the integration sends one clear write and requires two successful empty reads. If it fails, retry or turn this option off to keep the current schedules.

data.clear_local_schedules: Clear recurring on/off schedules stored in the purifier

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure device
reconfigure.description: Probe the address and verify the same device. X83C Plus experimental local power can be configured in the next step.

manual.title: Add a device manually
manual.description: Enter the current IPv4 address. MAC is optional; choose Auto to identify the product from its reply. An optional MAC adds an identity check. Auth and company fields apply only to legacy Air devices and can usually be left blank. Life devices support local discovery and connection status; X83C Plus has optional experimental power control.

no_devices.title: No new devices found
no_devices.description: Check that the device is online and reachable on the same local network, then retry. You can also use manual setup to choose from all supported models.

select_device.title: Select a discovered device
select_device.description: Choose a device. Legacy Air devices require model confirmation; Life devices show the available functionality before you add them.

confirm_local.title: Add a locally discovered device
confirm_local.description:
A local response identified {model} at {host}.

Local connection status is enabled by default. X83C Plus can optionally enable experimental local power control with legitimately obtained device accessKey and accessToken. It has not been hardware-tested and is likely not to work. Other Life models provide connection status only. Leave credentials blank to retain saved credentials.

data.experimental_life_control: Enable experimental X83C Plus local power control

error.model_mismatch: The selected model does not match the discovered protocol family

error.invalid_company: Enter a hexadecimal company code from 00 to FF, or leave blank
error.invalid_device: Select one of the discovered devices
error.mac_required_for_header: A MAC address is required when supplying legacy auth or company values
error.life_credentials_required: Device accessKey and accessToken are required for experimental control
